name: Flesh Blossom
source:
Welcome to Thorncliffe, a charming town with the most horrifying outbreak.

An otherworldly epidemic is spreading through town, and you’re the only one who can stop it. As Doctor Parsnip Green you’ll make difficult decisions as you operate on patients and investigate the disease’s origin. The fate of Thorncliffe is in your hands - will you save your patients or be driven to madness?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4421960/Flesh_Blossom/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到桑克利夫，这是一个迷人的小镇，这里爆发了最可怕的疫情。

一种超凡脱俗的流行病正在整个城镇蔓延，而你是唯一能够阻止它的人。作为欧洲防风草医生，你在为患者进行手术并调查疾病的起源时将做出艰难的决定。桑克利夫的命运掌握在你的手中 - 你会拯救你的病人还是被逼疯？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4421960/Flesh_Blossom/]Steam[/url]]
